_about: The editorial layer of the area pages (oria-v4/taxonomy-area.php, inc/area-guide.php). Everything counted -- places, practices, hours, prices, nearby suburbs -- comes from the live listings and is NOT stored here. What is here is hand-written: a place's own photograph, its one-line character, the local-rhythm introduction, getting around, and the public places the reset plans can use. Keyed by area term slug. Every claim must be checked before 'reviewed' is set; a data refresh never touches this file. An area with no entry still gets the full page, with its region's or city's photograph and data-only copy. Images: 'place_verified' is true only where the photo's own source title names that place; the others are fitting scenes, not claimed as the place, and their alt text says only what is in the picture.

image.alt: Early light down High Street, Fremantle, between limestone heritage buildings towards the Round House

fremantle.tagline: Limestone streets, sea air and one of Perth's strongest pockets for breathwork.
fremantle.rhythm_intro: Fremantle's wellness rooms sit in the same few streets as everything else here: back from the water, above shops, in converted heritage buildings. Breathwork, remedial massage and art therapy are all a short walk apart, which makes it an easy place to put two things into one visit.
getting_around: Fremantle Station is the last stop on the Fremantle train line from Perth.
Parking in central Fremantle is run by the City of Fremantle — check the signs and rates before a long appointment.

outings.name: Come for the company
outings.line: A free group meditation by the water, then breakfast nearby if you want it.
outings.cost: The meditation is free. Anything at the cafe is optional.

stops.detail: Saturdays at 6.30am: a welcome circle, a 20-minute guided meditation, then a closing circle. Open to beginners.
stops.join: Free and no registration. Meet at the hut in front of the art centre on Mews Road.

stops.detail: A courtyard cafe in a West End warehouse, serving wholefood breakfasts and lunches daily until 3pm. Its opening time is not listed, so check before you go.

outings.name: Time to unwind
outings.line: A private sauna session, some time under the pines, then something to eat.
outings.cost: Costs vary. The sauna is booked online, and the cafe is optional.

stops.detail: The South Terrace studio runs private infrared rooms for thirty minutes, and a private magnesium bath and sauna for sixty. Booking is online.
Wholefood breakfasts and lunches daily until 3pm, with vegan and gluten-free options.

elsewhere.resonate-mens-collective: Based in Fremantle, but meets across Perth: hikes in John Forrest National Park and Ellis Brook Valley, beach meetups at Trigg and walks around Lake Monger.
elsewhere.the-neighbourhood-sauna-fremantle: The studio is on South Terrace. Its beachside saunas at Leighton and Hillarys Boat Harbour are outside Fremantle.
